result_text:
The purchase-order count per sales rep now leaves out cancelled purchase orders.

**Change:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (around line 6514). I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the purchase-order subquery, matching the other per-rep counts and the per-quarter and latest purchase-order reports. I also updated its Javadoc to say cancelled purchase orders are not counted.

**Tests:** `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes with `mvn -q -o test`. I did not add a test that covers a cancelled purchase order, so the existing test does not exercise the new filter.

**Not changed:** `findPurchaseOrderCountPerCountry` has the same gap: it also counts cancelled purchase orders. The task only asked about the per-rep report, so I left it alone. It is a one-line change if you want it fixed too.

I have not committed anything.
